radar_model.note: R² is reported inside each site (spatial-block cross-validation). A pooled R² over the three sites is higher only because the sites differ so much; we do not use it. The model fails on an unseen site (Ahnet), so hotspots are compared inside each site only.

breaks.text: Gravity: Earth 9.81 m/s², Moon 1.62 m/s² (0.17 g)
Vacuum on the Moon; no wind, no weathering, very sharp regolith grains
Light: at the pole the Sun stays within a few degrees of the horizon; long shadows all day
Cold traps colder than anywhere on Earth inside permanently shadowed craters
